faithfulness.note: Geometry only. The registered geometry resolves with its claim class. The description states no pricing, so the label of each run names the pricing the run resolves. A run that declares a physics profile or constants is priced under them, and one that declares neither refuses absolute area, energy and latency by name.

stated.quote: Due to its outstanding performance on computing matrix-vector multiplications (MVM), memristor crossbars are widely used as dot-product accelerator in recent neuromorphic computing designs [19].
For quantizing structured pruned model, our framework achieves nearly no accuracy loss after quantizing weights to 8-bit memristor weight representation.
stated.reads: quantizing weights to 8-bit memristor weight representation

unstated.note: The sources state an 8-bit memristor weight representation and no cells per weight.
The sources state no memristor cell precision apart from the 8-bit weight representation.

Neither source states how a bias is held on the crossbars (yuan2019an Sec. III names each layer's biases b_i in training only); the registered geometry's bias row on the weight grid is the description's assumption.
The sources quantize weights only; the activation grid is the deployment's.
ma2019tiny places DACs and ADCs at the crossbar periphery (Sec. II) and states no ADC resolution; the deployment declares the converter law.
The sources state no on-chip activation, addition or pooling unit; absent, every activation, add and pool runs on the host.
The crossbars hold programmed memristor weights (ma2019tiny Sec. II); the description declares no run-time writable matrix.
